mostWorthwhile.text: Making the hydrothermal vent was worthwhile: it explained how seawater circulates through heated rock and returns carrying dissolved chemicals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the vent yielded no partners, despite its apparent relevance to minerals in seawater; it did not help identify the remaining route.

surprise.text: Rivers initially had no available combinations, but they became useful with weathered rock after the continent was formed and weathered.

arbitrary.text: The unavailable river–stone crust combination felt somewhat arbitrary at first, though the later weathered-rock result gave the distinction a clearer purpose.

continue.text: I would continue: the linked explanations of plate movement, hydrothermal vents and weathering made discovery interesting, despite a couple of unproductive checks.
